integrity: All-parameter algebraic proof with classical tent-map exactness and exact periodic-point enumeration; finite rational checker supplementary, not replacement for infinite proof. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicitly identified nondegenerate a1=0 Chebyshev parameter locus and its invariant box; no external attraction, nonlinear-persistence, generic-parametric hyperchaos or uniqueness of singular measures. Earlier literature may have an unindexed equivalent embedding.
title: The Chebyshev locus of a three-dimensional quadratic map: exact hyperchaos and periodic census
